label: shell_starting
title: Starting TraceCommons
body: Waiting for the daemon and its first explicit status read.

label: shell_refused
title: TraceCommons could not start
body: The daemon refused startup; the reason is retained.

label: tools
title: Tools
body: Choose tools to watch, customize folders, or use Private AI only.

label: uses
title: Uses
body: Choose Ask or Automatic and the uses allowed for traces. Neither sharing choice is preselected.

label: traces
title: Traces
body: Traces found and possible credit; discovery may still be empty.

label: private_ai
title: Private AI
body: Private AI information; this first run has no enable switch.

label: join
title: Join
body: Sign in with near.ai or use an invite. The current native Join offers no Skip.

label: shell_busy
title: Working
body: The current daemon call has not answered. Successful earlier calls remain recorded.

label: shell_error
title: Could not finish setup
body: The last daemon call failed; retry from the recorded progress.

label: shell_home
title: Home
body: Read-back comes from daemon status, queue and history.

label: shell_offline
title: Connection unavailable
body: The daemon status read failed; access gates treat onboarding as required.

label: shell_settings
title: Settings
body: Account, sources, privacy and update settings are separate operations.

label: shell_settings_saving
title: Saving settings
body: The daemon has not confirmed the new settings.

label: shell_update_busy
title: Checking for updates
body: Sparkle owns checks for a self-updating installation.

label: shell_update_external
title: Updates
body: The installer owns updates, or no updater feed is configured.

label: shell_empty
title: No window open
body: The application and daemon can continue while all windows are closed.

label: shell_stopped
title: TraceCommons quit
body: Calls are refused, subscriptions finish and the handle is drained or deliberately leaked.
